license.name: Charleston Acoustics
license.registry: West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board license verification (wvclboard.wv.gov/verify/)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-20. The board's public search (same endpoint the page's form uses) returned 0 records for company name 'Charleston Acoustics', 0 for 'Charleston Acou', and 0 for DBA 'Charleston Acoustics'. A broader name search for 'Acoustics' returned 1 record, but the result rows would not load outside the browser page, so it's not known whether that record is this company. Confirm with one browser search on the board site or a call to the board at (304) 558-7890. The company website (https://www.charlestonacoustics.com/) describes Charleston Acoustics Inc. as a supplier of commercial interior and specialty products, including toilet partitions and accessories. It lists stores in Charleston WV, Daniels WV, Huntington WV and Gallipolis OH, with Charleston office phone (304) 343-1332, and shows no WV contractor license number. A third-party government bidder directory (https://governmentbidders.com/government-bidders/contractor-5621124-CHARLESTON-ACOUSTIC.htm, from search results only, not opened) lists the company under NAICS 423390, a wholesale supply code. So it may be a distributor that doesn't install, and its install capability needs confirming before listing it as an installer. Local rule for Charleston: no separate city contractor license.
